candidate_relations.label: Appendiceal abscess post-appendectomy
candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes inflammation of the residual appendiceal stump (swollen tubular structure at cecal pole adjacent to surgical clips 8 months post-appendectomy) — the primary diagnosis is stump appendicitis. The pericecal collection is a complication of that process. C001 captures the complication and the post-appendectomy setting but omits the core diagnosis of stump appendicitis, making it a component/manifestation rather than a complete equivalent.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies the post-appendectomy context and a pericecal abscess as a complication, but does not name the primary diagnosis of stump appendicitis; the abscess is a complication/manifestation of stump appendicitis rather than the diagnosis itself

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis 'StumpAppendicitis' is well-supported by CT findings of a swollen tubular structure at the cecal pole adjacent to surgical clips in a post-appendectomy patient with leukocytosis and elevated CRP.
